decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the replacement hand railings to  
          the access ramp at the side entrance to the Library,  because of its 
          position, design and appearance, would be acceptable 
          having due regard for the site characteristics of  Brentford Library, a  
          Listed Building and is complementary to the visual amenity of the 
          locality and would not be detrimental to the amenities of adjoining and 
          neighbouring properties and will preserve and enhance the St Paul's 
          Conservation Area.  The development is in accordance with 
          Policies ENV-B 1.1 (New Development),  ENVB 1.8  (Access and 
          facilities for people with disabilities), ENVB 2.2 (Conservation Areas), 
          ENVB 2.5  (Development affecting the setting of a Listed Building), 
          ENVB 2.7 (Alterations to Listed Buildings and buildings of local 
          townscape character) of the London  Borough of Hounslow UDP, 
          adopted December 2003; and is compliant  with Council's "Think    
          Access" Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 3 - All new external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
description: Replacement of handrailing to access ramp at side entrance to site.
